strings.name: Brendan Eich
strings.summary: Eich created JavaScript at Netscape and helped develop Mozilla’s open-source project, foundation and Firefox. He briefly became Mozilla CEO in 2014, then resigned amid protests over his donation supporting a same-sex-marriage ban. He subsequently co-founded Brave with Brian Bondy, developing privacy-focused browser and search services.
